debugData.name: p341 alpha-cut test texture
debugData.description: p341 Phase 3: a plain texture with alphaCoverage, thin alpha-cut features (twigs thinning to 1 px, a fence of 1-4 px posts and 1 px rails, grass blades tapering to 0.5 px). Its mip levels are built by the pipeline and keep level 0's coverage at the cut 0.5.
